note: Gains locked in (compare.py): each workload must cost at most atMost times another of the same run, in the same unit. Measured on macOS (wall clock) when set: layout/5000/change 0.007 of layout/5000, frame/blink/400/drawn 0.21 of frame/400, frame/blink/400 0.46 of frame/400; the limits leave room for runners and callgrind.

locks.name: layout/5000/change
locks.why: one changed panel lays out only what it moves, not the whole tree

locks.name: frame/blink/400/drawn
locks.why: a blinking caret redraws only its damage region

locks.name: frame/blink/400
locks.why: a frame where nothing but the caret changed reuses the cached draw list

locks.name: watch/100000/change
locks.why: one changed file in a watched 100,000-file folder updates one row, never a new listing (0.14 on macOS)

locks.name: canvas/pan-100k
locks.why: a canvas draws what is in view (a spatial index), so 100,000 items pan about as fast as 1,000 (1.35 on macOS, 0.12 ms a frame against 8.3 ms at 120 Hz)
